note: THE weapon list (PLAN.md 2.8 item 7). Every weapon scene in the game is one row; the tools, the probes and AimDebugHost's bench read this instead of keeping their own lists. `archetype` is the GRIP ARCHETYPE by NAME (item 8) and must equal the scene's `weapon_archetype`; the index is derived at load (weapon.GripArchetype, append-only in blender/tools/weapon_archetypes.json). Per-model size data stays in blender/tools/weapon_models.json, keyed by these ids. `bench` = offered by AimDebugHost's shooting bench. Held to all of that by WeaponCatalogTest.

icon.note: Weapon icons (HUD radial menu, slot bar, kill feed) are generated by blender/tools/render_weapon_icons.py: an orthographic SIDE view, muzzle to the LEFT (the weapon's left side, as a CS kill-feed or buy-menu glyph reads), the whole model flat white on a transparent background, centred in one fixed frame. `scale` "fit" (shipped, user decision 2026-09-16) fills each frame: every weapon as large as its shape allows, proportions kept, relative size dropped — the HUD convention, because legibility at ~44 px beats true scale. `scale` "uniform" draws every weapon at `pixels_per_metre` (real relative size; the tool refuses a weapon that no longer fits). The frame matches the largest UI slot's shape (the radial menu's 133x44, 3:1) at ~3x its 1080p size. `side` = which side of the weapon faces the viewer and `muzzle` = which way the barrel points on screen; the natural view of the left side points the muzzle left, and the image is mirrored only when the two disagree. One PNG per weapon at `dir`/<id>.png; `review_sheet` is a contact sheet for eyeballing consistency, never loaded by the game.
